legacy_postcard_event.title: Automation uses a renamed Bird Buddy event
legacy_postcard_event.description: An automation or script still triggers on `{legacy_event}`, which this integration replaced with `{event}`. Update those triggers to `{event}`, whose payload carries `postcard_id`, `feeder_id`, `species` and `media`. Automations built on the "A new postcard is ready" device trigger continue to work and need no change.

application_credentials.description: Create a Web application OAuth client in [Google Cloud]({console_url}). Add the redirect URL shown by Home Assistant to its authorized redirect URIs. Request only email identity access. Your Bird Buddy account must already be linked to Google.
